name: contract-proof-resource-identity
goal: Ignore transient resource lease identities while retaining meaningful proof environment differences

evidence: A recorded red run on harbor-mbp-2 cannot be paired by a later resource-admitted green run because each admission creates a fresh HARNESS_RESOURCE_LEASE. The lease identifies resource ownership rather than a workload setting; the same-node green is rejected before executing tests.

The existing environmentProfile case exercises launcher identity but omits the resource lease introduced by managed commands. Strengthen that same case with distinct leases and explicit unchanged CPU/memory settings; retain assertions that runtime paths, feature flags and resource amounts change the profile. No test declarations added.
